subject: Renewal: doubling dedicated capacity — activation window, SLAs & invoice timing
messages:
From: Alicia Navarro <alicia.navarro@sparrow.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Turner <ben.turner@procure.sparrow.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity bump and timing questions

Hey Jordan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our engineering leads are ready to move forward with increasing our Dedicated pool from 8 → 16 GPUs at renewal, but we have two timing questions before I loop procurement: 1) What is the expected activation window once we sign (how many calendar days from order to live)? 2) Can we align the billing start date to the invoice cycle so we don't double-pay partial-month?

Ben (cc) will handle the PO if we can confirm those constraints. Also attaching our current SOW for reference — it lists the existing SLA targets.

Appreciate the quick clarity.

— Alicia
Director of ML Ops
Sparrow.ai

Attachment: Sparrow_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf, 180KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Navarro <alicia.navarro@sparrow.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity bump and timing questions

Hi Alicia — great to hear you're moving forward. Quick answers: 

- Activation window: standard activation for a 16-GPU reserved pool is 7–12 business days from executed order form. We target 7 days for existing customers with verified onboarding artifacts (network, keys, IP allowlists) and 12 days if we need to provision additional capacity in the region.
- Billing alignment: we can backdate or pro-rate the first invoice so the customer is billed from the start-of-cycle you prefer. Typically we align billing to the first calendar day of the next month if you need that — otherwise we start billing from activation date and pro-rate the partial month.

I'll loop in Marissa to confirm the activation runbook and Karthik for throughput SLOs once you confirm the target go-live date. If procurement needs a formal order form or DocuSign link I can send it today.

Jordan
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachment: activation-runbook-checklist.xlsx (xlsx, 12KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Alicia Navarro <alicia.navarro@sparrow.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity bump and timing questions

Alicia — thanks for the clear ask. A few operational notes from my side: 

- Pre-reqs that shorten activation to 7 business days: account VPC peering completed, firewall rules open for our control-plane egress, and any custom KMS/HSM integration tested on staging. If those are in place we can reserve capacity immediately upon signature.
- Throughput guarantee: for a 16-GPU pool we can commit to a baseline throughput of up to 4,500 tokens/sec aggregated (with continuous batching and a 256 token average request), and an end-to-end median tail latency SLO of <120ms for short prompts under the dedicated tier. Karthik, please correct if you want tighter wording for the SLO.
- On invoicing: we can set the invoice effective date to the first of next month and include a line-item for a pro-rated activation fee if activation falls mid-cycle.

Jordan — let me know the preferred go-live week and I’ll provide a target date and provisioning ETA.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Dedicated Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: 16GPU_throughput_profile.pdf (pdf, 72KB)

From: Ben Turner <ben.turner@procure.sparrow.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Alicia Navarro <alicia.navarro@sparrow.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity bump and timing questions

Hi all — procurement here. Two quick clarifications before I issue the PO: 1) We need the activation SLA and invoice effective date in writing on the order form; 2) Can Redwood accept Net 30 and show the billing start date as 2028-05-01 to align with our renewal window?

If you can produce an order form with those fields filled and a DocuSign link, I can get internal approvals this week.

Thanks — Ben
Senior Procurement Manager, Sparrow.ai

Attachment: none

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Turner <ben.turner@procure.sparrow.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Alicia Navarro <alicia.navarro@sparrow.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Apr 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity bump and timing questions

Ben — we can do that. I'll add the following language to the order form SLA section: 

"Activation target: Redwood will provision the doubled reserved pool within 7 business days from receipt of executed order form provided Sparrow.ai has completed required network and KMS onboarding steps. Billing start date will be set to 2028-05-01 (first day of month). If provisioning extends beyond 12 business days due to customer-side delays, Redwood will notify Sparrow.ai and provide a revised ETA; no additional fees will be charged for the provisioning delay.

Throughput guarantee: baseline aggregated throughput of 4,500 tokens/sec with median tail latency SLO <120ms for 256-token average requests. Redwood will run a post-activation load validation test within 48 hours and share telemetry.

Payment terms: Net 30 from invoice date.
"

I'll push this into the order form and drop a DocuSign link to Jordan to share.

— Karthik
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

Attachment: order-form-draft_16gpu.docx (docx, 34KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ben Turner <ben.turner@procure.sparrow.ai>, Alicia Navarro <alicia.navarro@sparrow.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Apr 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity bump and timing questions

Thanks Ben — DocuSign link below. Order form has the activation SLA and billing start date set to 2028-05-01, payment terms Net 30, and we included the throughput guarantee + post-activation validation language Karthik noted. 

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/SAMPLE-ENVELOPE-ID-7890
HubSpot Deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4321

Alicia — once signed we'll queue the provisioning job and aim for an activation window the week of 2028-05-06 (7 business days target; will confirm exact date after signature). Marissa will coordinate the provisioning checklist and run the validation test with your engineers.

Jordan
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachments: order-form-final_16gpu.pdf, invoice_schedule_proposal.xlsx
